title: Liquid Button
description: Hover and the button fills with liquid — a rising, rotating wave behind the label.
usage: The fill is a rotating blob on a rising carrier: hover lifts it past the label line and the rotation reads as a wave. The button stays a button — same size, same name, same keyboard behavior — with the liquid as its one party trick. Dark label on light, light label once filled; both states are token pairs, so themes keep working.
a11y: Fill is hover garnish: focus shows the standard focus ring, activation is unchanged, and touch users tap a perfectly good button that simply skips the pour. Under prefers-reduced-motion the fill snaps instead of rising.
